newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singmarine Industries seeks to change name.
newsitem.headline: Singmarine Industries seeks to change name.

text.p: Singmarine Industries Ltd said on Friday it was seeking shareholders' approval to change its name to Keppel Marine Industries Ltd.

It said in a statement the change was part of the larger plan of Keppel Corp Ltd to forge a stronger common identity among Keppel Group members in order that all benefit from the reputation and recognition of the group.
Singmarine is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Keppel Corp and is involved in shipbuilding, shiprepairing and engineering.
